policy.scope: 30 current named identities, not all 189 generic race/size/presentation families
policy.size_change: User requests size difference primarily through body volume rather than height; gameplay values remain unchanged by artwork.
policy.unknown_gender: null; unspecified appearance does not infer gender
policy.body_only: No weapons, spell effects, auras, floor shadows, text or scenery in body sheets
policy.authority_precedence: Current identity catalogs override historical image names, races, affinities and sizes; current style reference controls rendering rather than roster.
policy.readiness: A source asset or assigned recipe does not prove complete directional animation coverage or runtime acceptance.
